faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.sub: Find quick answers about using Jobrito
faq.bannerSub: Find quick answers about using Jobrito.
faq.noResultsSub: Try adjusting your search terms or filter.
faq.a1: Jobrito connects hospitality professionals with employers looking for Talent across restaurants, cafés, hotels, QSRs, cloud kitchens, catering and other hospitality businesses.
faq.q2: How do I find a job on Jobrito?
faq.a2: Browse the Job Feed to see available opportunities. You can review the job details and apply directly from the job card.
faq.q3: Do I need to complete my profile before applying?
faq.a3: Yes. A complete and updated profile helps employers understand your experience, skills and availability.
faq.q4: How do I apply for a job?
faq.a4: Open a job you are interested in and tap Apply Now.
faq.q5: Can I apply for more than one job?
faq.a5: Yes. You can apply for multiple jobs that match your experience and interests.
faq.q6: Can I cancel or withdraw my application?
faq.a6: Applications cannot be withdrawn after submission.
faq.q7: How can I know the status of my application?
faq.a7: You can check your applications and their current status from your Talent dashboard/profile area.
faq.a8: Pinned Jobs are priority opportunities selected by the Jobrito Admin team and highlighted for Talent.
faq.a9: Live Jobs are current job opportunities posted by employers and available for Talent to apply.
faq.q10: What is shown by default in my Job Feed?
faq.a10: Your Job Feed shows Live Jobs by default.
faq.q11: How can I view Pinned Jobs?
faq.a11: Use the Job Feed filter and select Pinned Jobs to view priority opportunities selected by the Jobrito team.
faq.q12: Can I apply for a Pinned Job?
faq.a12: Yes. Pinned Jobs can be viewed and applied for just like other available jobs.
faq.q13: Are Pinned Jobs more important than Live Jobs?
faq.a13: Pinned Jobs are highlighted by the Jobrito team as priority opportunities. However, you can apply for any job that matches your profile and interests.
faq.q14: Can I save a job for later?
faq.a14: Yes. Tap the Bookmark icon to save a job and review it later.
faq.q15: How do I remove a saved job?
faq.a15: Tap the Bookmark icon again to remove the job from your saved list.
faq.q16: Can I share a job with someone?
faq.a16: Yes. Tap the Share icon on the job and share it through your preferred app.
faq.q17: Can I refer a job opening?
faq.a17: Yes. You can post one job referral per day by tapping the + button on the Job Feed. Add the job, business and contact details to help spread the word about opportunities within the Jobrito community.
faq.q18: How will an employer contact me?
faq.a18: If an employer is interested in your application, they may contact you using the contact details you provided and during the time slot you selected when applying for the job.
faq.q19: Can I contact an employer directly?
faq.a19: No. You cannot contact an employer directly at first. You can exchange contact details only after the employer selects your application and chooses to contact you.
faq.a20: The Match % indicates how closely your profile matches the requirements and details of a particular job.
faq.q21: Why am I seeing jobs from other cities or countries?
faq.a21: Jobrito shows opportunities based on the job location preferences selected in your profile. If an employer posts a job for an overseas location, it may be shown to you if that location matches your preferences. If you select India Only, overseas jobs will not be shown in your Job Feed.
faq.q22: Can I apply for jobs outside my current location?
faq.a22: Yes, where the employer accepts applications from your location and you meet the job requirements.
faq.q23: How do I update my profile?
faq.a23: Go to your profile and edit the information you want to update.
faq.q24: Why should I keep my profile updated?
faq.a24: An updated profile helps employers better understand your experience and improves the relevance of job opportunities shown to you.
faq.q25: How do I change my phone number or account details?
faq.a25: Go to your profile/settings and update the information available for editing. For restricted account changes, contact Jobrito Support.
faq.a26: You can manage your Jobrito notifications from Settings & Support.
faq.q27: How will I know when a relevant job is available?
faq.a27: Jobrito may send notifications about relevant job opportunities and important updates based on your profile and preferences.
faq.q28: How do I contact Jobrito Support?
faq.a28: Go to Settings & Support → Help & Support to contact the Jobrito support team.
faq.a29: Jobrito uses your information to provide its services, connect you with relevant opportunities and support your account. See the Privacy Policy for more information.
faq.q30: How do I delete my Jobrito account?
faq.a30: Go to Settings & Support → Privacy & Security and select Delete Account.
faq.a31: These are upcoming training programs and overseas group hiring opportunities shared through Jobrito.
faq.q32: What is an overseas training program?
faq.a32: It is a training opportunity designed to help hospitality professionals prepare for potential overseas employment opportunities.
faq.q33: How will I know about upcoming programs?
faq.a33: Whenever an overseas training or group hiring opportunity is available, an agency may post the program through the Jobrito Job Feed. These posts will be visible to Talents who have selected overseas opportunities.
faq.q34: Can I apply for these opportunities?
faq.a34: Yes. When a program or overseas hiring opportunity is open, you can view the details and follow the application instructions provided.
faq.a35: No. Training programs and overseas group hiring are separate from regular employer job postings on the Job Feed.
faq.q36: Can completing a training program guarantee an overseas job?
faq.a36: No. Training participation does not guarantee employment. Overseas opportunities depend on the specific hiring program, employer requirements and selection process.
faq.q37: Where can I find these opportunities?
faq.a37: You can access them through the Training & Overseas filter/section in Jobrito.
